title: Police Capture Burglar With Stolen Firearm Attempting to Escape Over Fence
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Atlanta, Georgia — On October 9th, 2024, at approximately 9:44AM, officers responded to Biscayne Drive NW in reference to a residential burglary. The reporting party contacted 911 after observing an unidentified male on surveillance footage breaking into his home and stealing his firearm. The reporting party provided a description of the suspect to 911 dispatchers who then relayed that information to responding officers. 

Officers arrived at the location a short time later, where they observed a male matching the description that was provided. Upon seeing the officers approach, the suspect fled through an apartment complex on foot and attempted to elude officers by climbing up and over a tall fence. The suspect was unsuccessful though and was quickly apprehended by the responding officers. 

The suspect was placed into custody without further incident and officers were also able to recover the victim's firearm which the suspect attempted to conceal under a bush. The suspect was later identified as 33-year-old Kenneth Whack. Whack was charged with Burglary (1st Degree), Criminal Trespass/Damage to Property, Possession of a Firearm During the Commission of a Felony, and Obstruction of Law Enforcement Officers. Whack was transported to the Fulton County Jail for processing.
